mapper.select: SELECT T1.PARTY_NAME partyName, T1.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID partyCustomerId, T1.PARTY_ID partyId FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 on T2.COUNTER_NAME = T1.PARTY_NAME WHERE to_char(T1.UPDATE_TIME,'yyyymmdd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (T2.COUNTER_NAME IS NULL OR T2.PARTY_ID IS NULL)
SELECT count(*) FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA B WHERE B.SPARTY_ID = #{partyId} and B.MPARTY_ID is null
select CUSTOMER_ID from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_NAME = #{partyCustomerName}
SELECT COUNTER_ID FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY WHERE COUNTER_NAME = #{partyCustomerName}
